title: 第9章 大化三诡
content_zh:
射阳名侠威震江湖，怎能在敌人面前逃走？就算为了方姑娘而暂且忍辱躲避，但三鬼又怎能让人躲得开？这些事方姑娘是不会懂的。他向来不爱多说话，况且，这些事又何必跟她多说。这晚方玲翻来覆去地睡不安稳。她已在全心全意地关怀这个粗手大脚的乡下人，但秦英豪却睡得很沉。

    只不过他做了一个梦，梦见一顶花轿，一队吹鼓手，又梦见一个头上披着红巾的新娘子。那是很久很久以前童年时瞧见过的，他早已忘了，这时却忽然梦到了。醒来的时候，似乎还隐隐听到梦中鼓乐的声音。黯淡摇曳的烛光，照在旁边床上方玲像芙蓉花那样柔和、那样娇艳的脸上。这朵花却不在笑，她睡着的时候，也在恐惧，也在伤心和痛苦。她脸上有烛光，却有更多的阴影。

    次日清晨，秦英豪让服务员做一大碗烩面吃了，端张椅子，坐在厅中，龙雀宝刀放在身旁。他生平不爱事先筹划，预料的事多半做不了准，宁可随机应变。方玲见了他的神情，很是害怕，问了他几句，秦英豪并不回答，她就不敢再问。

    七八点左右，马蹄声响，三乘马在旅馆前停住，进来了三个客人。旅馆中人见了这三人的打扮，都吓了一跳。原来三人都身穿白色粗麻布衣服，白帽白鞋，衣服边上露着毛头，竟是刚死了父母的孝子服色。三身孝服已穿得半新不旧，若说在服热孝，却又不像。

    秦英豪知道大化三鬼武功实有独到造诣，那馄饨贩子武艺已自不弱，眼下大化三鬼亲自到来，此事当真棘手。见三人都脸色惨白，鼻子又扁又大，鼻孔朝天，中等身材的是副所长王超然，高而且胖的是办公室主任曹灿，身材瘦削的是研究员王长健。三人进来时脚步轻飘飘的宛如足不点地，果然是劲敌到了。

    秦英豪一生之中，敌人愈强，精神愈振，见三人身手不同凡俗，不由全身骨骼轻轻作响。三鬼上前同时一揖到地，齐声说：“秦大侠请了！”秦英豪拱手还礼说：“请了。恕在下腿上有伤，不能起立。”王超然说：“秦大侠你家腿上不便，原本不该打扰。只是你杀了我大化所成员，不能不报。请秦大侠恕罪。”秦英豪点点头。

    王超然说：“秦大侠威震天下，我们仨单打独斗不是你对手。一起上啊！”曹灿、王长健怪声答应，叫道：“一起上啊！”大化三鬼是武林中的成名人物，虽怪声怪气，怪模怪样，在江湖上却辈分甚高，行事持重，武功又强，因此在江湖上颇有声名。三人怪声一作，呛啷啷响声不绝，各从身边取出一对判官笔。

    旅馆中客人见这三人到来，早知不妙，这时见取出武器，人人远避，顿时大厅中空荡荡的一片。方玲关心秦英豪安危，却留在厅角中。秦英豪见她一个娇怯弱女居然有此胆量，大是欣慰。只因方玲在厅角这么一站，秦英豪自此对她生死以之，倾心相爱，向她微微一笑，抽出龙雀宝刀。

    三鬼见那刀青光闪动，寒气逼人，同声称赞：“好刀！”

    三鬼齐声怪叫。王超然双笔当胸直指，曹灿攻左，王长健袭右。秦英豪端坐椅中，横刀不动，待六枝镔铁判官笔的笔尖堪堪点到身边，突然宝刀一挥，呼呼风响，向三人各砍一刀。大化三鬼果然身负绝艺，见他刀势来得奇特，各自身形飘动，让了开去。他们只知秦英豪的射阳剑法独步天下，不料他刀法竟也如此精奇，心下均甚骇异。秦英豪此时使的是闵恩仇所授的北斗刀法，变化奥妙，灵动绝伦，只是吃亏在身子不能移动，一刀砍出，难以连续追击，否则数刀之间便可伤得三鬼中一人。

    四人一动上手，大厅中刀光笔影，顿时斗得凶险异常。三鬼轻功了得，分进合击，此来彼往，六枝判官笔宛如一人六臂所使。秦英豪使开刀法，攻拒削砍，丝毫不落下风。他想今日之斗务须猛下杀手，重伤他三人，否则自己与方姑娘性命难以周全。只素知三鬼安分守己，并无歹行劣迹，江湖上声名甚好，却不必取他们性命。眼见三鬼的招数愈来愈紧，每一招都点打他上身大穴，只要稍一疏神，不但一世英名付于流水，连这娇艳温柔的方姑娘也得落入敌手受苦。想到此处，刀招加沉，猛力砍削。三鬼怕他力大刀利，不敢让武器给他宝刀碰到了，围攻的圈子渐渐放远。

    曹灿眼见难以取胜，突然一声怪叫，身子斜扑，着地滚去，竟到秦英豪背后攻他下盘。这招甚是险毒，秦英豪在椅上不能转动，敌人攻他背后椅脚，如何护守得着？曹灿连攻数招，一笔横砸，咔嚓一声，将椅脚打断了一根。椅子一侧，秦英豪身子跟着倾侧。方玲“啊”的一声惊呼出来。秦英豪左手倏地探出，往曹灿脸上抓去。曹灿大惊，急忙滚开相避，当当两响，他与王长健手中的判官笔已各有一枝为宝刀削断。王超然肩头剧痛，却给刀刃划了一道口子。秦英豪一刀同时攻逼三敌，这招叫作“云龙三现”，是北斗刀法中的精妙招数。

    三鬼各展轻功跃开，三人互相望一眼，脸上皆有惊骇之色。曹灿问：“所长挂了彩啦？”王超然说：“不碍事。”他见秦英豪椅子斜倾，坐得摇摇欲坠，心想如此良机，日后再难相逢，只是忌惮他宝刀锋利，刀法精奇，抱拳说：“武器上我们仨不是敌手，我们再领教你的拳招掌法。”这话说的冠冕堂皇，却不怀好意，乃要敌人去其所长。他三人此来趁人之危，乃是仇杀拼命，并非比武较艺，秦英豪本来大可不必理会这番说话，但他是成名人物，艺高人胆大，一声冷笑，宝刀归鞘，点了点头说：“好！”

    三鬼抛下判官笔，蹦跳蹿跃，攻了上来。三鬼每一步都是跳跃，竟无一步踏行。秦英豪的掌法何等威猛，一经施展，三鬼欺不近八尺以内。也是大化所武功卓然成家，否则单是给他掌力一震，已受重伤。曹灿人最机灵，见他椅脚断了一只，已难坐稳，心想依样葫芦，再打断一只椅脚，非叫他摔倒不可，当下使出地堂拳法，滚向秦英豪椅后，猛地右腿横扫，咔嚓一响，果然又将椅脚踢断了一只。

    那椅子本已倾侧，此时急向后倒。秦英豪伸手在椅背一按，人已跃起。他恼恨曹灿狡诈，从半空中如大鹰般向他扑击下来。曹灿吓得心惊胆战，大叫：“王所长！长健！”王超然、王长健双双从旁来救。秦英豪双掌发力，左掌打在王超然肩头，右掌拍在王长健胸口，两人双双向外跌出。曹灿几个翻身逃出厅门，秦英豪也已摔倒在地。

    三鬼片刻间均为掌力震伤，见他如此神勇，哪敢进来再斗？曹灿瞥见旅馆门旁堆满草料，心念一动，取出火折晃着了，便在草料上一点。那麦秆干得透了，顿时起火，顺风烧向店堂。旅馆中服务员和客商见到火头，一阵大乱，纷纷奔出。三鬼拿着判官笔在门口监视，叫道：“谁救那坏了腿的客人，老子打开他的脑袋瓜子！”众人自逃性命不及，又有谁敢去救人？

    秦英豪见霎时间风助火势，浓烟火舌卷进厅来，自己双腿不能行走，敌人又守在门口，暗想：“难道我一世英雄，今日竟活活烧死在这里不成？”转眼见方玲已随众人逃出，心下略宽，火光中见屋角里放着一捆粗索，暗叫：“天可怜见！”爬着过去抖开绳索，在手臂上绕了十来圈。

    三鬼眼见烟火围门，这个当世无敌的秦英豪势必葬身火窟，三人心中大喜，相视而笑。

    方玲当危急时夺门而出，此时却想起秦英豪尚在店内，他为相救自己而受伤丧生，不禁大为难受，珠泪盈眶，正自难忍，猛听店堂内一声大喝，一条绳索从火焰中蹿出来，一端已卷住门外那株大银杏的树干。接着绳子一荡，秦英豪已飞了出来。

    众人见他突似飞将军自天而降，无不骇然。秦英豪左手抓绳，身子在空中向三鬼扑去。三鬼吓的魂飞天外，已无斗志，当即发足奔逃。三鬼轻功虽高，终不及秦英豪拉着绳子飞荡迅速，给他伸出蒲扇大的手掌，一掷一抓，一抓一掷，将三鬼先后投入火窟。总算三鬼武功均高，一入火堆，急忙逃出，但已烧得须眉尽焦，狼狈不堪。到此地步，三鬼哪敢逗留，马匹也不要了，向南急奔而去，但听秦英豪豪迈爽朗的大笑声，从身后不绝传来。
content_en:
The famous hero of Sheyang is so powerful in the world, how can he escape in front of the enemy?Even if he endures the humiliation and escapes for the sake of Miss Fang, how can the three ghosts be avoided?Girl Fang won't understand these things.He never liked to talk much, and besides, there was no need to talk to her about these things.Fang Ling couldn't sleep well that night.She was already caring for this rough-and-tumble countryman wholeheartedly, but Qin Yinghao was sleeping deeply.
It's just that he had a dream, dreaming of a sedan chair, a team of drummers, and a bride with a red scarf on her head.It was something he had seen in his childhood a long, long time ago. He had long forgotten it, but now he suddenly dreamed of it.When I woke up, I seemed to still vaguely hear the sound of drums in my dream.The dim and flickering candlelight shone on Fang Ling's face as soft and delicate as a hibiscus on the bed next to her.The flower was no longer smiling. When she fell asleep, she was also scared, sad and in pain.There is candlelight on her face, but there are more shadows.
Early the next morning, Qin Yinghao asked the waiter to make a large bowl of braised noodles and ate it. He took a chair and sat in the hall, with the Dragon Bird sword beside him.In his life, he doesn't like to plan in advance. Most of the things he predicts cannot be done accurately, and he would rather act according to circumstances.Fang Ling was very scared when she saw his expression. She asked him a few questions, but Qin Yinghao didn't answer, so she didn't dare to ask again.
Around seven or eight o'clock, there was the sound of horse hooves, three horses stopped in front of the hotel, and three guests came in.The people in the hotel were shocked when they saw how these three people were dressed.It turned out that the three of them were all wearing white burlap clothes, white hats and white shoes, with hair exposed on the edges of their clothes. They were the clothes of dutiful sons whose parents had just died.The three-piece filial piety attire has been worn for a long time. If it is said that they are wearing hot filial piety, it doesn't look like it.
Qin Yinghao knew that the Dahua Three Ghosts had unique martial arts skills, and the wonton seller's martial arts were already strong. Now that the Dahua Three Ghosts had arrived in person, the matter was really difficult.I saw that the three of them all had pale faces, flat and big noses, and nostrils pointing upward. The one with a medium build was deputy director Wang Chaoran, the tall and fat one was office director Cao Can, and the thin one was researcher Wang Changjian.When the three people came in, their steps were as light as if they didn't move. Sure enough, a powerful enemy had arrived.
Throughout Qin Yinghao's life, the stronger his enemies became, the more energetic he became. Seeing that the three people's skills were extraordinary, his bones could not help but creak softly.The three ghosts stepped forward and bowed to the ground at the same time, saying in unison: "Please, Master Qin!" Qin Yinghao returned the salute and said: "Please. I'm sorry for the injury on my lower leg, so I can't stand up." Wang Chaoran said: "Master Qin, you have inconvenience on your legs, so you shouldn't bother me. It's just that you killed a member of my Dahua Institute, and you have to avenge it. Master Qin, please forgive me." Qin Yinghao nodded.
Wang Chaoran said: "Qin Daxia is so powerful in the world. The three of us are no match for you if we fight alone. Let's go together!" Cao Can and Wang Changjian agreed in a strange voice and shouted: "Let's go together!" The Three Ghosts of Dahua are famous figures in the martial arts world. Although they have strange voices and strange looks, they are very senior in the world, behave solemnly, and have strong martial arts, so they are quite famous in the world.The three of them made strange noises and made endless noises, and each took out a pair of judge pens from their sides.
When the guests in the hotel saw these three people arriving, they knew something was wrong. When they saw the three men coming, they took out their weapons and everyone stayed away. The hall suddenly became empty.Fang Ling was concerned about Qin Yinghao's safety, but stayed in the corner.Qin Yinghao was very pleased to see that a timid and weak girl like her had such courage.Just because Fang Ling stood in the corner of the hall, Qin Yinghao loved her wholeheartedly, smiled at her, and drew out the Dragon Bird Sword.
The three ghosts saw the sword flashing with green light and the cold air, and they all praised in unison: "What a great sword!"
The three ghosts screamed in unison.Wang Chaoran pointed directly at his chest with both pens, Cao Can attacked on the left, and Wang Changjian attacked on the right.Qin Yinghao was sitting in his chair, holding his sword motionless. When the tips of the six Iron Judge pens came to his side, he suddenly swung his sword and struck each of the three with a whirring sound.As expected, the three ghosts of Dahua possess extraordinary skills. Seeing the strange power of his sword, their bodies fluttered and moved away.They only knew that Qin Yinghao's Sheyang sword technique was unparalleled in the world, but they were surprised that his sword technique was so exquisite.Qin Yinghao was using the Beidou sword technique taught by Min Enchou at this time. It had mysterious changes and was extremely agile. The only disadvantage was that he couldn't move his body and it was difficult to pursue continuously with one strike. Otherwise, one of the three ghosts could be injured within a few strikes.
As soon as the four people started to fight, the hall was filled with flashes of swords and pens, and the fight suddenly became extremely dangerous.The three ghosts have mastered Qinggong. They move forward and attack together, coming and going. The six judge pens are like being used by one person and six arms.Qin Yinghao used his knife skills to attack and resist cutting, without falling behind at all.He thought that in today's battle, he must strike hard and seriously injure the three of them, otherwise his and Miss Fang's lives would be in danger.I just knew that the three ghosts were safe and kept to themselves, had done no evil deeds, and had a good reputation in the world, but there was no need to take their lives.Seeing that the moves of the three ghosts were getting tighter and tighter, each move hit a large hole in his upper body. If he relaxed even a little, not only would his fame be ruined, but the charming and gentle girl Fang would also fall into the hands of his enemies and suffer.Thinking of this, the sword moves became heavier and he slashed hard.The three ghosts were afraid of his powerful sword and did not dare to let their weapons come into contact with his sword. The besieging circle gradually widened.
Seeing that it was difficult to win, Cao Can suddenly let out a strange cry, threw his body sideways, rolled to the ground, and got behind Qin Yinghao to attack him.This move is very dangerous. Qin Yinghao cannot turn in the chair. How can he protect the enemy from attacking the legs of the chair behind him?Cao Can attacked several times in a row, smashed horizontally, and broke one of the chair legs with a click.On one side of the chair, Qin Yinghao leaned forward.Fang Ling exclaimed "Ah".Qin Yinghao's left hand suddenly reached out and grabbed Cao Can's face.Cao Can was shocked and hurriedly rolled away to avoid each other. With two bangs, one of the judge pens in his and Wang Changjian's hands had been cut off by the sword.Wang Chaoran felt severe pain in his shoulder, but the blade made a cut.Qin Yinghao attacks three enemies at the same time with one sword. This move is called "Three Appearances of Clouds and Dragons", which is an exquisite move in the Beidou sword technique.
The three ghosts each displayed their Qinggong skills and jumped away. The three of them looked at each other with a look of horror on their faces.Cao Can asked: "Has the director lost his honor?" Wang Chaoran said: "It doesn't matter." He saw Qin Yinghao's chair tilted and he was sitting precariously. He thought that such a good opportunity would never happen again in the future, but he was worried about the sharpness of his sword and his exquisite sword skills.The three of them came here to take advantage of others' danger, but to kill each other with a vendetta, not to compete in martial arts. Qin Yinghao didn't need to pay attention to these words, but he is a famous figure, and a man of skill is bold. With a sneer, he sheathed his sword, nodded and said: "Okay!"
The three ghosts dropped the judge's pen, jumped up and attacked.Every step the three ghosts took was a leap, but they didn't even take a step.Qin Yinghao's palm technique is so powerful. Once used, the three ghosts cannot get closer than eight feet.It was Dahua Suo who had outstanding martial arts skills, otherwise he would have been seriously injured just by a shock from his palm.Cao Can was the cleverest person. Seeing that one of the legs of his chair was broken, he could no longer sit firmly. He thought of doing the same thing and breaking another leg of the chair, which would make him fall down. He immediately used the Jitang boxing technique and rolled behind Qin Yinghao's chair. He suddenly swept his right leg across, and with a click, he kicked another leg of the chair off.
The chair, which was already tilted, fell backwards.Qin Yinghao reached out and pressed the back of the chair, and he jumped up.He was angry at Cao Can for being cunning and pounced on him from mid-air like an eagle.Cao Can was so frightened that he shouted: "Director Wang! Changjian!" Wang Chaoran and Wang Changjian both came to the rescue.Qin Yinghao exerted force with both palms, his left palm hit Wang Chaoran's shoulder, his right palm slapped Wang Changjian's chest, and both of them fell out.Cao Can turned around and fled out of the hall, while Qin Yinghao also fell to the ground.
The three ghosts were all injured by the force of his palms in a moment. Seeing how brave he was, how could they dare to come in and fight again?Cao Can saw a pile of fodder beside the hotel door. With a thought in his mind, he took out the fire folder and shook it, then put some on the fodder.The wheat straw was so dry that it immediately caught fire and burned towards the shop with the wind.When the waiters and merchants in the hotel saw the fire, there was a chaos and they ran out one after another.The three ghosts were watching at the door with a judge's pen, and shouted: "Whoever saves the guest with a broken leg, I will open his head!" Everyone fled with their lives, and who dared to save others?
Qin Yinghao saw that the wind was blowing up the fire in an instant, and thick smoke and flames were rolling into the hall. He could not walk with his legs, and the enemy was guarding the door. He thought to himself: "Is it possible that I, a lifelong hero, was burned alive here today?" In a blink of an eye, he saw that Fang Ling had escaped with everyone.
When the three ghosts saw the fireworks surrounding the door, the invincible Qin Yinghao was bound to be buried in the fire cave. The three of them were overjoyed and looked at each other with smiles.
When Fang Ling was in danger, she rushed out of the door, but then she remembered that Qin Yinghao was still in the store. He was injured and died trying to save her. She couldn't help but feel very uncomfortable. Tears filled her eyes. Just as she was unbearable, she suddenly heard a loud shout in the store. A rope jumped out from the flames, and one end of it had wrapped around the trunk of the big ginkgo tree outside the door.Then the rope swung, and Qin Yinghao flew out.
Everyone was shocked when they saw him suddenly falling from the sky like a flying general.Qin Yinghao grabbed the rope with his left hand and jumped towards the three ghosts in the air.The three ghosts were so frightened that their souls flew into the sky. They had no fighting spirit and immediately ran away.Although the three ghosts' Qinggong skills were high, they were not as fast as Qin Yinghao's hand on the rope. He stretched out his hand as big as a cattail leaf fan and threw the three ghosts into the fire cave one after another.After all, the three ghosts were all highly skilled in martial arts. Once they got into the fire, they hurriedly escaped, but their men and eyebrows were all burnt and they were in a miserable state.At this point, the three ghosts didn't dare to stay. They gave up their horses and rushed south. However, Qin Yinghao's heroic and hearty laughter kept coming from behind.
